CostSnap — AI Estimating & Quoting for Contractors

# Price the job from a photo. Run the shop. 

CostSnap is the AI estimating and quoting app built for contractors. Price the work from photos, then manage intake, leads, calls, and branded quotes in one place.

- ✓ Photo estimates
- ✓ Client portal & leads
- ✓ AI call centre

 

Trusted by contractors and tradespeople worldwide

60s From photo to quote

175+ Countries supported

12+ Trades covered

4.9★ Average app rating

## Photo estimates. Then the office.

Photograph the job, review a local labor-and-materials range, apply your rates, and send a professional quote. Paid plans add the tools that run the rest of the business.

### Photo estimates

AI reviews job photos and optional voice notes, then returns scope, measurements, and a local price range you can edit.

### Client portal

Clients submit photos and job details through your branded page. Every request arrives in one place.

### Leads

Track inbound work in a single list and convert a lead into a job when you are ready to quote.

### AI call centre

Answered or missed, every call is saved to Leads with a full transcript.

### Your catalog

Set labor rates, materials, markup, and travel so every quote reflects how you charge.

### Warranty & white label

Track coverage after the job and send quotes with your logo and branding.

Smart and Unlimited include these business tools.

Click a step. See the call become a lead, the photos become a draft, and the draft become a branded quote — without another trip just to measure.

4. 04 AI drafts the price Photos plus postal code become a local labor-and-materials range you can edit. 
5. 05 You send the bid Your catalog, travel, tax, and logo. They review it. You close.

## Everything the shop needs — explained.

Pick a tool. See what it does, who uses it, and how it connects to the next job.

### Price the job from a photo

AI reads job-site pictures and optional voice notes, then returns scope, measurements, and a local labor-and-materials range. You edit every line before anyone sees a number.

- Works from the truck or the office
- Postal code sets the local range
- You lock the price — not the model

### A branded door for every client

Share your CostSnap page. Clients upload photos, notes, and the address. Every request arrives as a job you can quote — no more hunting through texts.

- Your name and logo on the page
- Photos land on the job, not in your camera roll
- They can review the quote in the same place

### One list for inbound work

Calls, portal requests, and manual notes sit in Leads. Filter by status, convert a lead into a job, and keep shopping work out of the calendar until you are ready.

- New, contacted, booked, won, lost
- Calls-only filter when you want the phone
- Turn a lead into a job in one tap

### Every call becomes a lead

Answered or missed, the conversation is transcribed and attached. You hang up. CostSnap writes the record. Follow-up starts from the transcript, not from memory.

- Full transcript on the lead
- Missed calls still become work
- Quote the same afternoon

### Your rates, every time

Labor, materials, markup, tax, and travel live in the catalog. Travel can price itself from shop to job. Quotes stop being a blank spreadsheet.

- Labor and material lines you reuse
- Tax from location or your override
- Travel from distance when the rate is not zero

### Jobs, schedule, crew

Accepted work sits on the calendar. Assign a tech, filter by status, and see what is unscheduled. The homepage cards show the pipeline you care about.

- Color-coded status filters
- Book from the calendar
- Team assignments on each job

### Quotes that look like your shop

White-label PDFs with your logo. Clients approve in the portal. Turn an accepted quote into an invoice and track unpaid work.

- Your branding on every bid
- Approve, then invoice
- Unpaid filter on the jobs list

### Coverage after the job

Start a warranty when the work is done. Clients see coverage in the portal. You see what is active, claimed, or expired — not in a filing cabinet.

- Active, claimed, expired
- Tied to the finished job
- Included on Smart and Unlimited

## Questions contractors ask

Everything you need to know before you start.

Who is CostSnap built for?

CostSnap is built for contractors and tradespeople — plumbers, electricians, roofers, painters, HVAC, remodelers, concrete, and handymen — who need to price jobs quickly and send a professional quote.

How accurate are the AI estimates?

Estimates use your photos plus country and postal code for a local labor-and-materials range. You override it with your catalog, rates, and markup before you send the bid.

Can I quote a job without visiting the site?

Yes. The client sends photos through the portal — or you snap them on site. CostSnap drafts the estimate. You edit and send.
